title: Artifacts Can Now Call MCP Connectors
description: Published artifacts can now pull live data and take actions through each viewer's own MCP connectors when they view the artifact. This enables dashboards to show live data and interactive apps instead of static displays.

community_feedback.quote: A solution that reduces Claude Code context consumption by 98%
Claude driven PRs are riddled with ~7.5 issues worthy bugs

title: Mid-Conversation System Messages
description: Claude now supports mid-conversation system messages, allowing for more dynamic control of agent behavior during ongoing conversations.

title: Cursor in Slack Improvements
description: Cursor in Slack now shares a plan before starting tasks, runs in multi-repo environments, and can work across channels and threads. Includes refined response rendering with compact footer links and cleaner display of tables, PRs, and artifacts.

title: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Side chats allow asking questions and exploring ideas without interrupting main agent conversations. Added ability to search agent transcripts with local search index that scales to thousands of conversations.

community_feedback.quote: What if we could open a mini thread off a specific message — like Discord or Slack — to ask side questions without messing up the main

title: Redesigned Project and Repo Pickers
description: Simplified project and repo pickers with powerful new features. Users can create projects and connect GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps without leaving the picker. Search is now scoped to current working location.

title: Team MCPs and Organization Groups in Marketplaces
description: Admins can configure Team MCP servers once and distribute them across cloud agents, agents window, IDE, and CLI. Team marketplaces now support organization groups in addition to team-level SCIM directory groups.

title: Copilot Usage Tracking and Alerts
description: Refreshed Copilot Usage window reflects usage-based billing model with real-time updates and proactive alerts when approaching limits, hitting limits, or when overages activate.

title: Trust Validation for MCP Servers
description: Visual Studio now compares MCP server configuration and asset fingerprint against a trusted baseline at startup. If anything changed, a trust dialog asks to review and approve before the server runs.

title: C++ Modernization Agent Generally Available
description: The MSVC upgrade scenarios for the modernization agent have graduated from preview. Run in Automated mode for end-to-end upgrades or Guided mode to review assessment, plan, and execution before each step.

title: AI Credit Pools for Cost Centers
description: GitHub introduced AI credit pools for cost centers, allowing Copilot users to see AI credits used per billing cycle. Copilot usage metrics are now available via two new API endpoints for Business and Enterprise users.

title: Devin Desktop v3.4.27 Released
description: Fixed issues with diff viewing in autonomous mode. This release updates bundled Devin components and improves overall stability.

title: Devin Desktop v3.4.22 Released
description: Added 'New session in space' to session menu, Devin Cloud sessions auto-reconnect when network returns, images can be copied from chat via context menu, and new users default to agent mode. Multiple bug fixes and improvements.

title: Version 0.144.4 Released
description: Patch release with no user-facing changes (maintenance update). Codex continues to receive weekly updates with focus on stability and performance.

title: Inline Visualizations and Improved Code Mode
description: Added support for inline visualizations in Codex tasks. Improved code mode functionality and fixed fast mode selection issues.

title: Restored Context Windows for GPT-5.6 Models
description: Fixed bundled instructions for GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models and restored their 272,000-token context windows. Fixed installer issues.

title: Visual Studio Code 1.129 Released
description: VS Code 1.129 introduces a dedicated agent host feature, a new editor panel in the Agents window, and the ability to run commands from chat interactions. Update addresses various issues with 1.129.1.

community_feedback.quote: The new Modern UI started off being just bad, but looking at the enhancements they're applying I feel like it's going to be pretty solid

title: Main Branch Updates
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models and updated model aliases. Expanded Gemini model support with 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, added Gemini 3 preview models. Added DeepSeek Reasoner model with updated metadata.

title: Aider v0.86.1 Released
description: Added reasoning_effort setting for GPT-5 models and disabled temperature by default for the GPT-5 family to improve deterministic outputs.

title: Repo Map Enhancements
description: Repo map now tags Fortran, Haskell, Julia, and Zig and is compatible with newer tree-sitter Python APIs. Enhanced language support for better code analysis across more programming languages.
